description:
Hushfeed v0.30.1 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Media saves now keep stable Photo Mode indexes, enforce their deadline and clean up clear-display captions as soon as their switch changes. Hook status catches more reflection failures. Settings search, Feature Gate Lab, diagnostics and native pickers also received another usability and accessibility pass. The project page now leads with the approved H and real settings screens, with direct paths to install and compatibility details.

Validation: 1045 runtime tests passed locally, plus 119 in the patches module. The bundle carries 71 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. Both Android API checks passed. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
